speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To help understand your condition, have you noticed any changes in the color of your urine or stool recently? Also, have you experienced any abdominal pain or nausea?

speaker: Patient
text: 20-year-old male. The patient was previously healthy and has been brought to the emergency department due to agitation over the past 24 hours. Family members have noticed a yellowish coloring of his skin and eyes over the past week. The patient has a history of occasional cocaine and ecstasy use, and drinks alcohol socially on weekends. The patient also admits to high-risk sexual behaviors without using appropriate protection.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of high-risk sexual behaviors and new-onset jaundice, have you experienced any right-sided abdominal pain, dark urine, or pale stools? I also need to know if you have had any recent fevers, chills, or muscle aches.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any recent fevers, chills, or muscle aches, and have you noticed if your urine has become dark or your stools pale? I need to determine if this is an acute viral hepatitis, so I will also check for tender hepatomegaly during the physical exam.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant past medical history. Social history: Occasional use of cocaine and ecstasy. Social alcohol consumption (about 20 g on weekends).

speaker: Doctor
text: I need to clarify if you have experienced any recent fevers, chills, or muscle aches, as these are common systemic symptoms of acute viral hepatitis. Additionally, have you noticed your urine turning dark or your stools becoming pale?

speaker: Patient
text: The patient shows signs of psychomotor agitation and confusion. No other symptoms provided.

speaker: Doctor
text:
REQUEST TEST: Liver Function Tests, Hepatitis Panel, Coagulation Profile
Given the agitation and jaundice, I need to rule out acute liver failure or severe hepatitis, so please also check for any asterixis or signs of hepatic encephalopathy during the physical exam.
